correctness.rationale: Theorem 2 and finite Proposition 2 of Alvarez imply the complete reverse-inclusion congruence classification. Every nonempty upset has a unique earliest occupied layer and trace; crossing intervals give two necessary-and-sufficient conditions. Uniqueness of maximal proper archival upsets yields SI; no proper nonempty archival upsets yields simplicity. EGF/OGF via ordered lists of independent levels, and the stated two dominant-pole residues, prove the all-size census and limiting constants. Independent direct archival, graph-reachability, and rational-series enumerations agree for all labelled frames through n=5 and coefficients through n=8. Limits of finite checks are made explicit.

The exact congruence-lattice normal form determines more than simplicity, and all-size labelled/unlabelled enumerations with sharply opposed limiting frequencies separate structural behaviors on a canonical infinite-parameter non-chain family.
